branch_findings.full_pocket: 20 occupied slots cause 0xee1420 to call 0xee0ed0 and then 0xefbd30; a 19/20 pocket skips both, including 0xf99270.
branch_findings.material_descriptor: In the full fixture, 0xee0ed0 copies Material1 (item 2213) to the temporary output, and 0xefbd30 receives those exact 8 bytes. This is separate from the result descriptor.
branch_findings.per_material_marker: At +0x3c (Material1 record +0x10), zero routes all six material rows through 0xee1060. One routes Material1 through 0xeff060 while five unmarked rows still use 0xee1060.
branch_findings.result_descriptor: The result ID 975 from param2+8 reaches 0xefab90 then 0xefac20 after the pocket-full path. In the unmodified partial actor-registry fixture, 0xefac20 takes an equality early return at 0xefac98 before pocket lookup; controlled no-match variants subsequently reach 0xf987c0 and mutate a free slot.

result_insert_static_route.interpretation: The indexed recipe entry has one direct result-award chain through 0xefab90 -> 0xefac20 -> 0xf987c0. Other direct callers of the shared insert helper exist, but no alternate result-specific handler is called from 0xee1420.

branch_findings.result_insert_fixture_followup: With a controlled actor resolver and explicit no-match registry response, the real 0xf987c0 is reached. In the 19/20 case it writes result 975 into slot 19 and sets marker +0x16f to 0xff without calling 0xf98650. In the 20/20 case, preceding native compaction opens slots and 975 appears in slot 4; the marker range was already set by compaction. These synthetic cases prove the insert helper mutation, not a complete live-game award or save.
branch_findings.compaction_observation: On the synthetic 20-record fixture (each raw record [2213,0,1]), 0xf99270 rewrote 24 slots through 0xf98650; the first four raw records became [2213,0,9], the remaining slots became [65534,0,0], and all 20 primary dirty bytes became 0xff. The u32 payload field is reported raw; its gameplay count meaning and conservation rule are not established.
